metadata.title: studio smoke: altimate tools
metadata.prompt: Call altimate_core_equivalence again for the same two queries (`SELECT a, b FROM t WHERE a > 1` vs `SELECT b, a FROM t WHERE a > 1`), this time passing schema context inline: `CREATE TABLE t (a INT, b INT)`. Also run finops_query_history if it works without a warehouse (if it errors, that is fine, just report the error). Then stop and summarize in 2 sentences.

spans.name: user-message
spans.input:
Please do exactly these two things using tools, then stop:
1. Use the altimate_core_equivalence tool to check whether these two queries are equivalent: `SELECT a, b FROM t WHERE a > 1` and `SELECT b, a FROM t WHERE a > 1`.
2. Use the sql_format tool to format: `select 1 as x,2 as y from information_schema.tables where 1=1`.
Do not use any other tools. Summarize results in one short paragraph.
